_note: Few-shot competency-question examples per persona. Drawn from PMDco / MaterialsMine CQ patterns and adapted to copolymer research. These prime the LLM with the right tone, depth, and grounding style. Aim: 2-3 high-quality examples per persona, each anchored on a hypothetical paper so the LLM mimics the form without copying the content.

SYNTH.question: Which polymerization mechanism was used to synthesise the styrene-acrylate copolymer reported in the paper?
SYNTH.expected_answer: RAFT polymerization with a trithiocarbonate chain-transfer agent.
SYNTH.grounding_note: Anchored on a named material and a named mechanism.

SYNTH.question: What initiator concentration was used for the bulk polymerization step?
SYNTH.expected_answer: AIBN at 0.5 mol% relative to total monomer.
SYNTH.grounding_note: Specific named reagent + numeric value with unit.

PROC.question: How did the foaming temperature influence the cell size of the copolymer foam?
PROC.expected_answer: Increasing the foaming temperature from 110 to 140 °C reduced the average cell size from 85 to 35 µm.

PROC.question: What CO2 saturation pressure was used to produce the lowest-density foam?

COMP.question: Which machine-learning algorithm was used to predict the copolymer composition from the feed ratio?

STU.expected_answer: Dispersity is the ratio Mw/Mn, indicating how broad the molecular weight distribution is; a value near 1 means a narrow distribution.
